articles.summary: Ecolab Inc. (NYSE: ECL): THIRD QUARTER HIGHLIGHTS Strong execution drove broad-based acceleration, with reported sales growth of 13% and organic sales growth accelerating to 7%. Volume growth improved to 2% despite ongoing Middle East disruptions, while pricing accelerated to 5%. Growth in Ecolab's core businesses strengthened, led by accelerating growth in Food Beverage and Light Water. Heavy Water and Paper both returned to solid growth. Ecolab's growth engines accelerated, driven by 63% organic sales growth in Global High-Tech and 17% organic sales growth in Life Sciences. Ovivo Electronics and CoolIT also performed exceptionally well and, one year after close, are expected to contribute approximately 2 percentage points to Ecolab's annual organic sales growth. Reported operating income margin 17.3%. Organic operating income margin 19.6%, +70 bps. Reported gross margin 44.1%.
